title: Horizontal and vertical Cut Out
summary: Remove an unwanted strip, preview the joined image as you drag, and undo the cut in one step.

Added: More > Cut Out removes straight horizontal or vertical strips with either drag direction.
The canvas previews the joined image using existing texture slices. Plain images commit on mouse release; editable objects show a flattening review with Cancel.
One Undo restores the prior dimensions, pixels and editable objects. Projects retain the original image for Revert.
Verified: Native horizontal review/Cancel/apply and vertical release commit, Undo/Redo and save passed on synthetic content.
A combined 80-pixel horizontal and 150-pixel vertical cut matched all156800 saved pixels against an independent array comparison.
Engine tests cover exact RGBA at both joins and image edges, one-pixel survivors, invalid strips, preserved Redo, save/reopen and original restoration.
Shortcut eligibility is tested during drag, flatten review and idle Cut Out, preserving keyboard Undo after release.

limitations: Straight edges only. Torn, wave, zigzag and reference preset matching remain unfinished.
Cutting an image with editable objects flattens them after review; Undo restores editability. The drag preview stays anchored to the original image until commit.
This unsigned historical alpha covers only the workflows verified in its release notes.
